description:
Before the show, get into the mood.

A quiet countdown for your next concert, festival, or livehouse. Not a ticket wallet. Not an itinerary. Just a private space to slowly get closer to this one night.

Save your first 5 shows for free, then grow your free capacity by 1 show each calendar month. A Home Screen widget can keep the countdown in sight.

BeforeShow helps you:
• See the next show — the home screen holds one current show and its countdown
• Light reminders — only using facts you already saved
• Bring a show in — paste a link, scan a screenshot, or type it yourself
• Keep the night — a short rating, a note, and memory fragments that stay yours
• Festival timetable — every stage side by side, overlaps at a glance
• Pre-show listening — stage-by-stage mixes to warm up before doors open
• Lock Screen countdown — Live Activity and Dynamic Island show who's on stage
• Home Screen widgets — see how long is left without opening the app

How it works
1. Save your next concert, festival, or livehouse
2. Watch the countdown as the night gets closer
3. After the show, leave something behind and find it later in Footprints

The free plan starts with capacity for 5 saved shows, then can grow by 1 show each calendar month; deleting a show frees capacity. Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, and unlocks unlimited new shows. Prices are shown in the App Store at purchase.

promotionalText: More reliable Live Activity reminders, daily Listen disc picks, a lighter timetable, and a quicker after-show exit.
whatsNew:
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island deliver more reliable “Want to see” reminders
• Listening reminders recommend a disc each day, with smart daily artist rotation
• Timetable performance cards use light glass; single-stage shows get a clearer horizontal layout and larger avatars
• Finish the after-show ceremony without the dispersal card when you want a quicker exit
